memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him. For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just, so that the Lord will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him." - Gen 18:18-19 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God reveals why He drew close to Abraham: "I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord." God's purpose for Abraham was not merely personal blessing; it was that Abraham would pass on the ways of God to those who came after him. He was blessed in order to become a channel of faith to his family and, through them, to all nations.

This is a vital truth about God's calling. He does not bless us for ourselves alone. He entrusts us with faith so that we might pass it on - to our children, our households, the generations that follow. Faith is not meant to end with us; it is meant to flow through us.

Notice the everyday shape of this calling: Abraham was to "direct his children and his household... by doing what is right and just." This isn't primarily about grand religious moments, but about the daily task of teaching, modelling, and living out God's ways at home. The most important discipleship often happens around the family table.

This is a sacred responsibility for every believer. "Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road" (Deut 6:7). And the call to "make disciples of all nations" (Matt 28:19) flows from this same heart. You are blessed to be a blessing. Who is God calling you to pass your faith on to?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Are you passing your faith on to those who come after you?
- Who has God placed in your household or life to disciple?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that You bless me not for myself alone but to pass faith on to others. Help me direct those in my care in Your ways, by what I teach and how I live. Let faith flow through me.
Amen.
